notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing that much damage to any target(s).
